puzzle.hint: Provisions and means of livelihood granted for survival on earth
puzzle.arabicVerse: وَلَقَدْ مَكَّنَّـٰكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَجَعَلْنَا لَكُمْ فِيهَا مَعَـٰيِشَ ۗ قَلِيلًۭا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ
puzzle.verse: 7:10 - And We have certainly established you upon the earth and made for you therein ways of livelihood. Little are you grateful.
